topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Rain's been coming down sheets all day, like it's trying to wash away marks that'll never come clean. Found this bear at a yard sale, old as the hills, soft as a memory. Kids, they don't understand what finding a bear like this means, but you, you remember. That kid, it was you, standing in the rain, holding onto something that made the world a little softer, a little kinder. You paid what they asked, not caring. Got back to my place, and the bear sits here, looking out the window, like it's waiting for someone who ain't coming back. Sometimes, you can't help but think, maybe we all are.
